cohort: The study included 60 primigravida postnatal mothers who had undergone a cesarean section, divided into an intervention and a control group.
finding: Neck massage was found to be effective in significantly improving breast milk production and various newborn parameters (baby's weight, urination, and stool frequency) in postnatal mothers.
mod_finding: The study cohort specifically included primigravida mothers who had undergone a cesarean section, indicating that neck massage is effective in this particular mode of birth group.
